Fun Facts: World Catan #1, Australian Powerlifting Champion, State Discus Champion, organised national conferences that brought 2000+ Australians in to think about creating meaningful change in society.

founders.name: Zaky Hassan
founders.bio: Zaky is a protein biochemist and viral structural biologist who has characterized mechanisms of antibody neutralization in human pathogenic coronaviruses. He has an undergraduate degree in Biochemistry (Honours BSc) and graduate training in Biochemistry (PhD candidate) from the University of Toronto. He was awarded $130K+ in fellowships, and published twice in Nature Communications. Zaky previously founded a non-profit, raised $1M+ in grants and operated programming for 1000+ youth in Toronto.

founders.name: Min Jin
founders.bio: Min is a viral structural biologist and protein biochemist, and the current world record holder for the highest resolution structure of a coronavirus spike protein in the Protein Data Bank (1.68 Å). She has an undergraduate degree in Biophysics (Honours BSc) and graduate training in Biochemistry (PhD candidate) from the University of Toronto and she has published in Nature Microbiology and Nature Communications.

name: Neuromorphic
description: Building robots to automate wetlabs

founders.name: Vatan Aksoy Tezer
founders.bio: Founder at Neuromorphic. Previously Lead Robotics Engineer at Augmentus, deploying motion planning algorithms to production with sub-mm accuracy and leading a team of 5. Before that, built navigation stacks from scratch at KABAM Robotics (deployed 100+ robots) and scaled ASRS systems at Rapyuta Robotics (1000+ robots to production). Core maintainer of MoveIt at PickNik Robotics. MS in CS from Sabanci University, BS in Astronautical Engineering from Istanbul Technical University.

founders.name: Ege Doganay
founders.bio: Founder at Neuromorphic (YC S26). Robotics and AI research at Bilkent University. Research fellow at Nanyang Technological University. Published research in top AI and robotics conferences. Won HackMIT, Stanford XR, MIT Reality Hack.

founders.name: Cem Toker
founders.bio: Founder at Neuromorphic. Co-founded ErgoFlow, building LLM routing and training acceleration. Previously developed static calibration algorithms for industrial robots at Zeeko achieving 30% higher precision. Engineering at Cambridge.

name: Gamgee

founders.name: Paul Conyngham
founders.bio: Founder at Gamgee Technologies (YC S26), building personalised mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs. Gamgee grew out of my work using AI and genomics to help my dog Rosie fight cancer. Previously co-founded Core Intelligence, building applied AI systems across startups and enterprise, and helped grow Australia’s AI community as a founding member of the Data Science & AI association of Australia. Background in ML, data science and electrical and computer systems engineering

MEng in Biomedical Engineering from Imperial College London, dropped Oxford PhD in AI Safety (for Health). Awarded academic scholarships for both.

founders.name: Ayush Patel
founders.bio: Co-Founder at Osseus (YC S26). 2x intern at Apple, where he built an agentic QA system. MEng in Computer Science from Imperial College London.

founders.name: Sebastian Apelgren
founders.bio: Co-founder & CEO at Ordo Labs. Former lead quantitative researcher at Handelsbanken, one of the largest Nordic banks. Studied Engineering Mathematics at KTH Royal Institute of Technology and quantitative finance at the National University of Singapore.

founders.name: Kristina Hoang
founders.bio: Co-founder & CPO at Ordo Labs. Previously co-founded SecureTag, a pharma authentication platform developed with experts from AstraZeneca, Novo Nordisk and Bayer, and piloted with Uganda’s National Drug Authority. She has spent years building software for regulated pharma workflows. MS in Industrial Engineering & Management and MS in Machine Learning from KTH.

founders.name: Adam Tovatt
founders.bio: Co-founder & CTO at Ordo Labs. Co-founded Sakur, a software consultancy serving YC companies and European fintechs. Previously lead backend engineer at Careless, an AI-first UK insurance broker. Backend engineer at Redeye as well as Tradera, the largest Nordic secondhand marketplace. Has shipped production systems across insurance, lending and debt management.

founders.name: Mattias Akke
founders.bio: Founder at Halmos Labs. Previously LLM researcher at MIT (Gómez-Bombarelli's lab) and AstraZeneca, developing frontier models for drug discovery. Published at NeurIPS on Bayesian optimization with LLMs. Research intern at Cambridge in Tuomas Knowles' group studying protein misfolding diseases. Chaired Kodsport Sverige, Sweden's largest competitive programming organization. Awarded Berzelianum grant by Swedish Royal Academy of Sciences (one chemist awarded per year).

founders.name: Linus von Ekensteen Löfgren
founders.bio: Founder at Halmos Labs. Previously Desk Quant at Danske Bank, building pricing algorithms and risk models across all asset classes. Conducted LLM security research at AI Sweden and quantum computing research at Chalmers. MS Engineering Physics and BA Economics from Lund University.
